briefing.headline: AMZN jumps 5.8% overnight
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech showed a split picture with Amazon up 5.8% while Apple and Microsoft slipped modestly. Broad market ETFs (SPY, QQQ) edged lower, indicating a cautious tone. Biotech and specialty names led the extremes: FMC surged 37.9% and SNDQ rose 30.2%, whereas INTW collapsed 58% and several small‑cap stocks fell 20‑30%. Overall breadth was mixed, with as many decliners as advancers among the core tickers.
